title: TOPS (BSC) NEM-class burn-from-pair + sync() gate resolved: closed price-state gate, self-defeating fee re-swap, $0 external-unprivileged
closed_reasons: Recycle gate CLOSED live: priceTracker.currentPrice=118773020285185430, getTokenPrice()=123295621430803540, threshold=tracked*1.02=121148480690889138 -> priceRose2Percent=true -> _handleSellRecycle returns early (no burn)

No outsider entry: blockConfig.buyEnabled=false blocks every pair-outbound TOPS transfer - router buy reverts 'Buy is disabled' (masked 'Pancake: TRANSFER_FAILED'), direct pair.swap reverts, and even pair.skim() reverts, so no unprivileged party can acquire TOPS

Burn is self-defeating: _swapTokenForCake() re-swaps the 20% sell fee into the SAME pair, so for any fee-bearing sell d(reserve1) = -burn + fee >= 0 (fork: 100000 TOPS sell -> burn 10000 but reserve1 INCREASES by 10000)
Best-case drain cost ~$96427 (burn reserve1 at fee/burn ~1) > reward reserve0 $96379 -> net negative before gas

Only unopposed burn is the amount<10000 rounding hole (fee = floor(amount/1e4)*rate = 0), capped at 999 wei/call, and the sender's deposit is trapped (skim blocked) -> ~10:1 loss; 1.56e19 calls needed for 2% of reserve1

LP exit is also blocked while buyEnabled=false: router.removeLiquidity reverts 'not allow to remove' (masked) because the pair pays USDT first, flipping _isRemoveLiquidity()>0 into require(feeWhiteList[recipient])

Runtime bytecode contains exactly one 0xfff6cae9 (sync()) immediate - the external ISwapPair(mainPair).sync() inside _handleSellRecycle (token.sol:744); no skim/getReserves/flushLpSellRecycle/burnFromPool/recycle/flush immediate

The gate is NOT a privilege gate: _handleSellRecycle is a sell hook (recipient=mainPair, takeFee), reachable by any unprivileged seller; there is NO external function for the burn (fork-proven: TokensRecycled emitted once the day rolls over and trackedPrice resets to spot)

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live from the TOPS NEM-class candidate: the burn-from-pair + sync() is a sell hook behind a price-state gate that is closed at block 129280478, buys are disabled so no outsider can obtain TOPS (and even skim() is blocked), and the burn is self-defeating because the sell fee is re-swapped into the same pair so reserve1 never collapses; fork-verified 11/11.
